stock.description: Trio Industrial Electronics Group Limited functions as an investment holding company, specializing in bespoke engineering and contract manufacturing services for diverse sectors. Their comprehensive product range includes electro-mechanical devices, switch-mode power supplies, smart charging systems, intelligent vending solutions, automated testing apparatus, power switchgear panels, and control boards designed for catering equipment. The company also manages global material sourcing and procurement, participates in the production and distribution of electronic goods and components, and provides extensive sales, marketing, and customer support services. These products are widely utilized in various industrial and commercial settings, such as renewable energy installations, telecommunication infrastructure, commercial freight equipment, medical and healthcare technology, leisure and entertainment devices, and security and access systems. Founded in 1983 and based in Hung Hom, Hong Kong, the company operates internationally, with a presence in the United Kingdom, Switzerland, Ireland, Denmark, Sweden, North America, the People's Republic of China, Southeast Asia, Israel, and Australia. Trio Industrial Electronics Group Limited is a subsidiary of Trio Industrial Electronics Holding Limited.
